result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: overlapping/garbled metadata text under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card makes its delivery info unreadable. Other partially visible items are intentional horizontal-scroll and bottom-viewport cutoffs.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata line (delivery time / delivery fee / cuisine) has overlapping, garbled text. Characters from two text elements are superimposed around '25-30', making the line unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout/positioning of the metadata text elements so they do not overlap. Ensure only one delivery-time/delivery-info string is rendered on a single line with proper spacing, e.g. '25-30 min • €0 delivery • Ramen'.
